text: Based on the NASA FIRMS satellite data, there were **no fire detections** on or near the property (ASSET-F04) during the period from **October 4, 2026, to November 3, 2026**. The analysis covered all days in the period using multiple sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21, and MODIS), and no thermal anomalies or active fires were detected intersecting the asset. The coverage was continuous, confirming no burning occurred.
